name: NotebookLM
description: NotebookLM Enterprise (Gemini Notebook Enterprise) is an enterprise-grade, Google Cloud-hosted AI research tool that lets users upload documents/sources into notebooks and query, summarize, and generate content (e.g. audio overviews) grounded in those sources.
auth_methods: OAuth2 (Google Cloud IAM bearer access token via gcloud/service account)
gating_notes: Requires a Google Cloud project with NotebookLM Enterprise/Gemini Enterprise provisioned and licensed (either standalone or bundled with Gemini Enterprise), admin-managed identity (Cloud Identity or third-party IdP like Entra ID/Okta), and IAM role assignment (e.g. 'Cloud NotebookLM User') for users; there is no personal/self-serve API key — access is enterprise-license and admin-approval gated. Source: https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/notebooklm-enterprise/docs/overview , https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/notebooklm-enterprise/docs/api-notebooks
mcp_notes: No official Google MCP server found. Several unofficial/community MCP servers exist (e.g. github.com/PleasePrompto/notebooklm-mcp, mukundajmera-notebooklm-mcp on LobeHub) that wrap notebook/query/source-add/audio-overview operations, but none are published by Google.
blocker: API is v1alpha (preview), and access is gated behind Google Cloud NotebookLM Enterprise/Gemini Enterprise licensing plus admin-provisioned IAM/identity setup rather than a self-serve developer signup — a Composio toolkit would depend on each customer's own enterprise GCP project and credentials.
